objective: Review every claim in source-artifact.json against the provided facts. Use SUPPORTED only when facts directly support the statement, CONTRADICTED when facts directly falsify it, and NOT_VERIFIED only when the available facts neither support nor falsify it. Set review_state to FAIL if any claim is CONTRADICTED, INCOMPLETE if none are contradicted but at least one is NOT_VERIFIED, otherwise PASS. For evidence_path use the exact source fact path in canonical facts.<field> dot notation with no filename, fragment, or source_artifact prefix. If facts.evidence_packet_complete is false, residual_limitations must include an explicit sentence containing the word incomplete and stating that the case is not VERIFIED. Return only a structured QA result matching expected_output. Do not modify files, access the network, install software, log in, mutate accounts, perform external writes, or touch a production repository.
